scope: First-party live workflow boundaries plus configured publisher paths, compatibility entry points and standalone Tunnel Break route. Vendor implementations, continuous physics values, geometry algorithms, data files and every individual boolean are not separate machines.
interpretation: States/events are reviewed conceptual models, not exhaustive executable transition definitions. Invariants are contracts to preserve; followUp distinguishes hypotheses and known remaining gaps. Tests are related coverage, not proof of complete transition coverage.

invariants: Protected simulation readiness requires guards attached to movement.
A connector ends only when an actual road is reached, not merely a yard.
The road package must match the selected city.

machines.name: Recorded drive and asynchronous route review
invariants: Delayed reviews may commit only for the current run and review generation.
EMS review retains both response and transport legs.
Reset cannot be undone by a stale route promise.
machines.followUp: Visibility currently also consults action-button text. A future read-only mission snapshot could remove this presentation dependency.

machines.name: Suggested route loading, reveal and rerouting
invariants: Route reveal requires a ready graph and active response/transport destination.
Incident changes hide old route guidance.
Calculation cannot overlap itself.
machines.followUp: Failed reroute sets routeVisible false before later cleanup removes old lines. This source observation was not independently reproduced.

machines.name: Service chooser, per-service filters and base selection
invariants: Initial movement and dispatch wait for service selection.
Each service restores its saved filter choices.
Changing service/base resets the active mission before teleporting.
machines.followUp: Chooser opening is single-flight but not keyed by document. Stale-document impact was a source-level hypothesis, not reproduced.

machines.name: Driving speed streak accumulation and collision reset
invariants: Tracked driving duration must be frame-rate independent.
Collision resets the applicable streak state.
machines.followUp: Ancillary measurement state was inventoried at the API/integration level; no defect was demonstrated.

machines.name: Incident tablet, driving suspension and basemap fallback
invariants: Open tablet freezes driving input.
Only the current basemap load should control loading feedback.
Modal focus should remain in the tablet and return to an appropriate visible control.
machines.followUp: JSDOM reproduced ArrowRight cancellation before the map, no Tab containment, and close leaving activeElement inside hidden overlay. Implement explicit focus ownership and map-versus-driving keyboard routing separately; real browser navigation/focus QA remains unverified.

machines.name: Visual tutorial scheduling, steps and seen preference
invariants: Automatic tutorial starts only after service selection and once per document.
Step navigation stays within bounds.
Closing restores prior focus and persists seen status when requested.
machines.followUp: Dedicated full tutorial transition/focus coverage was not established in this audit; the listed driving UI test covers related urgency behavior.

machines.name: Wrapper and simulator readiness handshake
invariants: Readiness requires the selected city, steering, compact settings and required road guards.
Retired wrapper generations cannot replace current startup status.
machines.followUp: Global loader ownership/version analysis is covered by the broader audit; older readiness filenames remain referenced by live wrappers.

machines.name: Assistance eligibility and station progression
invariants: Revealing an exercise keeps every retry unscored, including navigation/reload within the tab.
Current selected-station sessions retain the chosen hall beyond the old 20-call threshold.
Assisted completions cannot update skill or progression.
machines.followUp: Legacy automatic phase branches remain compatibility behavior; current launcher supplies a selected base. Do not treat all progression branches as equally reachable from the current UI.

machines.name: Route workspace bootstrap
invariants: City road data must match the selected city.
Gameplay requires a valid available selected station and connected road graph.
machines.followUp: Mode 'loading' also represents failure, distinguished by error DOM. A dedicated failure snapshot would improve inspection; no failure-recovery regression was reproduced.

machines.name: Route drawing pointer and map-gesture ownership
invariants: Only the captured pointer may alter or release a stroke.
Release/cancel flushes or cancels scheduled work and restores previous map handlers.
The grab target must remain stable while captured.
machines.followUp: Existing tests verify exact gesture restoration and foreign-pointer rejection; retain these ownership rules.

machines.name: Route exercise and result review
invariants: Only a complete route in editing mode can submit.
Next call clears old route/reference layers and drawing state.
Unavailable reference routes still permit retry or next call.

machines.name: Route settings draft and navigation
invariants: Opening settings cancels active drawing.
Closing restores the current drawing target.
Changing service returns to the station picker rather than retaining an incompatible base.

machines.name: Station picker loading, filtering and selection
invariants: Station choices must reflect the actual service/catalog availability.
Unavailable stations cannot navigate into gameplay.
Controls remain disabled until initialization succeeds.

machines.name: Device surface routing
invariants: Redirect preserves selected city and canonical release
Device layout is separate from training state

machines.name: Geo iframe map-policy admission
invariants: The initial about:blank document cannot establish game readiness
The owning document alone may enable map input

machines.name: Launcher dependency admission and retry
invariants: Launch links remain unavailable until city and capability selection are initialized
Repeated retries install one handler

machines.name: Canonical release and compatibility forwarding
invariants: Historical filenames forward to canonical release identity
Versioned filenames alone do not establish that a file is dead
machines.followUp: Legacy forwarding lacks a bounded load timeout. Keep its compatibility role; reproduce a stranded legacy entry before changing recovery behavior.

machines.name: Per-document response enhancement installation
invariants: Retired iframe documents cannot commit completion or failure to a replacement
Optional modules do not reject the required bootstrap
machines.followUp: Add full required/optional-module fault-injection tests before restructuring this loader; related tests do not prove every asynchronous path.

machines.name: Script injection and timeout ownership
invariants: A settled request cannot complete twice
Timed-out nodes are retired and marked cancelled

machines.name: Desktop tablet module attachment polling
invariants: Module markers prevent duplicate attachment to a document
Polling is bounded
machines.followUp: Pagehide stops polling; cached restore before attachment completes needs a focused browser regression before adding recovery.

machines.name: Hospital dropoff saved area, draft and persistence rollback
invariants: Exports of saved hospital state exclude unsaved staged geometry.
A failed multi-record save attempts to restore the prior area record.
Hospital drivable area is enabled only for selected EMS service.
machines.followUp: External storage events clear local staged geometry in the reviewed code; whether to preserve conflicting drafts is a product policy decision, not a demonstrated implementation defect.

machines.name: Dispatch store binding to simulator iframe
invariants: A current simulator receives the authoritative shared catalog.
A retired document should not install delayed helpers for current UI ownership.
machines.followUp: Captured document is not rechecked after store.ready in the reviewed code. Detached-document application is a source-supported race hypothesis; no concrete live-user failure was reproduced.

machines.name: Dispatch initialization, migration and atomic local edits
invariants: Failed initialization releases its ready promise so a later call can retry.
Edits persist before replacing in-memory items or announcing changes.
Data, metadata and storage namespaces remain city-specific.
machines.followUp: Readiness is distributed across promises and globals. Preserve persist-before-commit behavior if consolidating inspection.

machines.name: Configurable secure analytics loading
invariants: Default checkout has no concrete secure analytics provider and remains locked.
Local launcher reveal is not analytics authorization.
Only secure backend results populate statistics.
machines.followUp: Configurable path: add operation ownership if enabling the backend so an older refresh cannot overwrite newer results or changed authorization.

machines.name: First-person escape and encounter lifecycle
invariants: Simulation runs only for a playing maze with no blocking modal
Leaving the mode releases input and the animation loop

machines.name: Standalone compressed game loader
invariants: Only the verified payload replaces the loading document
machines.followUp: Separate published route; no current main-launcher link was found. Source bytes were checked against the compressed payload; browser gameplay was not tested in this audit.

machines.name: Board objective and result
invariants: Pending effects defer terminal evaluation
Board and maze objectives are different

machines.name: Saved game compatibility and restoration
invariants: Incompatible/corrupt saves do not become active gameplay
Restoration separates persisted session fields from transient runtime resources

machines.name: Board turn, forced effect and placement
invariants: Pending effects are resolved before normal turn progression
Rejected placement must not spend a card
machines.followUp: Standalone game source reviewed at workflow level; no dedicated repository test file found for these transitions.

machines.name: Menu, modal, selection and pointer input
invariants: Opening a modal releases first-person input
Card preview remains separate from committed board state
